concerns.text: The implementation plan (plan.md) describes a **phylogenetic generalized least‑squares (PGLS)** model that includes `body_mass_g` as a confounder (see Phase 5 description). No task in tasks.md implements PGLS or references `body_mass_g`; the closest task (T005) fits a Linear Mixed‑Effects Model (LMM) without body mass. This leaves the plan element uncovered.

Similarly, the plan’s interaction model (Phase 5) is specified as a PGLS with interaction terms. Tasks.md only defines interaction LMMs (T006) and does not address the phylogenetic correlation structure or the body‑mass covariate required by the plan.

The specification mandates an LMM, but the plan switches to PGLS (see plan.md). While tasks.md follow the LMM approach, the plan’s PGLS requirement is not satisfied by any task, creating a mismatch between plan and task coverage.
